content.label: Services
content.subTitle: The best images of your event
text: Drones for use in the city are useful for various tasks, such as capturing aerial images for audiovisual productions, infrastructure inspections, or emergency services.

However, it is necessary to obtain a special permit from DGAC-Ecuador-(RDAC 101) to operate in what is known as CTR (Air Traffic Control) because these areas have a higher density of air traffic and specific safety protocols must be followed.
It is important to have authorized and experienced professional operators to ensure flight safety and compliance with air regulations in these areas.

callToAction.title: Our commitment to safety and professionalism
text: At JB.SkyLens we work under strict safety standards and in compliance with the official regulations of DGAC-Ecuador-(RDAC 101). Our team of professional pilots guarantees legal, safe, and efficient aerial operations in every project.

We manage permits, registrations, and mandatory requirements so that every flight is in order, because we understand that in aerial work, safety, responsibility, and legality are not optional—they are part of the service.

one.subTitle: INTRODUCTION
one.text: This Privacy Policy describes how your personal information is collected, used, and shared when you visit or make a purchase from https://dron.joaobarres.dev (referred to hereinafter as the 'Site').

two.subTitle: 1. PERSONAL INFORMATION WE COLLECT
text: When you visit the Site, we automatically collect certain information about your device, including information about your web browser, IP address, time zone, and some of the cookies installed on your device.

Additionally, as you browse the Site, we collect information about the individual web pages or products you view, the web pages or search terms that referred you to the Site, and information about how you interact with the Site.
We refer to this automatically collected information as 'Device Information'.
We collect Device Information using the following technologies:

list.description: Cookies are data files placed on your device or computer that often include an anonymous unique identifier. For more information about cookies and how to disable them, visit http://www.allaboutcookies.org.
items: Persistent Cookies: These cookies remain on your device until you delete them or your browser automatically removes them after a set period of time.
Third-Party Cookies: These cookies are placed through our Site by our advertising and analytics partners. These cookies may recognize your computer both on our Site and on other websites.

text: This website and associated services are operated by JB.SKYLNES - DRON, established under the laws of Ecuador. The terms "we", "us" and "our" refer to JB.SKYLNES - DRON; "you" and "client" refer to the Contracting Party.

three.subTitle: 2. PURPOSE OF THE CONTRACT
text: The purpose of this contractual relationship is the provision of professional aerial and ground video recording services using unmanned aerial vehicles (drones), audiovisual production, editing and digital material delivery, as well as the granting of usage licenses over the produced material, in accordance with these Terms and current Ecuadorian legislation.

four.subTitle: 3. PRODUCTS AND SERVICES
text: JB.SKYLNES - DRON offers image and video capture services using drone technology for events, commercial, real estate, advertising and other projects. We strive to display our results as accurately as possible on the website. However, weather, lighting and environmental conditions may influence the final product, without this constituting a breach of contract. Services will be provided in accordance with the regulations of the General Directorate of Civil Aviation (DGAC) of Ecuador.

five.subTitle: 4. PRICING AND PAYMENTS
five.text: Prices vary according to the type of service, event duration, location and type of usage license requested. All prices are expressed in US dollars (USD), the legal tender of Ecuador.

description: To confirm and reserve the service date, a deposit of 50% of the total agreed amount is required. The remaining 50% must be paid on the day of the event or upon arrival at the location where the client wishes to carry out the recording, prior to starting work. The date is reserved only once the deposit has been received and verified.

The submission and confirmation of the 50% deposit payment will act as an express declaration of intent and will constitute a binding contract between the client and JB.SKYLNES - DRON, making all these Terms and Conditions fully valid and enforceable from that moment, in accordance with Art. 1461 and following of the Ecuadorian Civil Code and Art. 48 of the Law on Electronic Commerce, Electronic Signatures and Data Messages. The client declares full knowledge and acceptance of these Terms upon making said payment, without the need for an additional signature.

In the event that weather conditions pose a risk to the safe operation of the drone (excessive wind, rain, fog, electrical storm or other adverse conditions), the final decision on the feasibility of the flight belongs solely and exclusively to the pilot operator of JB.SKYLNES - DRON. This determination will be made based on the safety of people, property and the aircraft, and no client, contracting party or third party may demand the flight under conditions the pilot considers unsafe.

Rescheduling due to weather — already at the location: If the pilot is already present at the recording location and weather conditions prevent the flight, requiring the service to be rescheduled to another day, a surcharge of USD $10.00 will apply for mobilization costs incurred. This amount must be paid by the client before the new recording date.

Prior notice with 1 hour in advance: If the client or pilot notifies at least one (1) hour before the start of the service that weather conditions do not allow the recording to take place, rescheduling will not generate any additional mobilization cost. In this case, a new date will be coordinated by mutual agreement between the parties with no financial penalty.
JB.SKYLNES - DRON offers the following service packages. The price of each package will be provided in the personalized quote.
items: Package 1 — Basic (Express Coverage): 20 to 30 minutes of flight. 3 edited photos. 2 short videos (30 seconds each). Ideal for: quick content, social media, specific moments.
Package 2 — Premium (Full Coverage): 1 to 1.5 hours of flight. 15 edited photos. 10 short videos (varying duration). Basic editing included. Ideal for: events, nightclubs, brands.

Package 3 — VIP (Advanced Production): 1.5 to 2 hours of flight. 25 edited photos. 20 short videos (30 seconds each). Advanced and detailed editing. Ideal for: large events, advertising campaigns, clients with high demands.

Package 4 — Technical Inspection: Flight time according to project scope. Detailed technical photos and inspection videos. Applications: vessels, infrastructure, land (encroachments, mining, among others). Material delivered ready for technical or expert analysis.

Package 5 — Promotional / Tourism: Cinematic shots (beaches, businesses, hotels and tourist attractions). Photos and promotional video. Editing focused on marketing and brand or destination promotion.

Extras: Fast delivery in 24h (additional cost), additional videos and photos (cost per unit), out-of-zone mobilization (based on distance, see clause 4.6), rescheduling due to weather while already at the location (USD $10.00, see clause 4.2).

description: Weddings, quinceañeras, graduations and other long-duration events have a differentiated rate according to the time and effort the service demands, clearly detailed in each quote.

The standard coverage area of JB.SKYLNES - DRON includes the city and parish of Esmeraldas, within a radius of up to ten (10) kilometers from the operations base point located at geographic coordinates Latitude 0.96730, Longitude -79.65209. All services rendered within this area will not incur any additional mobilization cost.

If the event or recording takes place outside the standard ten (10) kilometer coverage radius described in clause 4.5, an additional mobilization cost will apply, which will be informed in advance and expressly stated in the quote, based on the distance and conditions of the location.

six.subTitle: 5. MATERIAL DELIVERY
text: Once the event and editing process are complete, all material will be delivered 100% digitally to the client.

description: The material is sent through digital platforms (Google Drive, WeTransfer or similar). The client will receive a download link directly via WhatsApp or email. The Service Provider will not be responsible for the loss of the link once it has been sent.
Delivery time depends on the contracted package and the amount of material to be edited, as specified in the quote. Deadlines begin from the conclusion of the event.

In accordance with Articles 107 and following of the Organic Code of the Social Economy of Knowledge, Creativity and Innovation (INGENIOS Code, Official Registry Supplement No. 899, December 9, 2016), all video recordings, aerial images, shots, sequences, compositions, edits, post-production and any other audiovisual content generated during the provision of services are works protected by copyright, whose original and exclusive ownership belongs to JB.SKYLNES - DRON as author and audiovisual producer.

JB.SKYLNES - DRON expressly reserves, in accordance with Art. 123 of the INGENIOS Code, all moral and economic rights over the generated works, including: (a) the right of reproduction; (b) the right of distribution; (c) the right of public communication; (d) the right of transformation or adaptation; and (e) the right of making available to the public. These rights may only be exercised by the client through an express license or written assignment.

The Service Provider reserves the right to use fragments of the produced material for its professional portfolio, advertising, social media and commercial demonstrations. If the client does not wish their material to be used for these purposes, they must communicate this in writing at the time of contracting, which may imply an additional fee for full exclusivity.

eight.subTitle: 7. USAGE LICENSES GRANTED TO THE CLIENT
text: Delivery of the material to the client does not imply transfer of copyright ownership, but only the granting of a usage license, as contracted and pursuant to Articles 127 and following of the INGENIOS Code.

description: Unless otherwise agreed, the client receives a non-exclusive, non-transferable license without sublicensing rights, for personal and private use of the material. This includes: (a) personal viewing and enjoyment; (b) publication on the client's personal social media accounts with mention or credit to the Service Provider when possible; and (c) non-commercial sharing with family and friends. Any commercial use, advertising, direct or indirect profit, sale or sublicensing of the material is expressly prohibited under this license.

When the client requires using the material for commercial, advertising, marketing, real estate purposes, monetized platforms, paid advertising (ads), mass distribution or any activity that generates direct or indirect economic benefit, they must expressly contract the Commercial Use License, which carries an additional cost on top of the base service price.

The Commercial Use License grants the client the non-exclusive right to use the material for the specific purposes agreed upon in the quote or license contract. The geographic scope, duration, permitted distribution channels and other conditions will be established in writing. This license does not imply transfer of copyright ownership.

If the client wishes to acquire full ownership of the economic rights over the produced material, including the right of modification, sublicensing, unlimited reproduction and total commercial exploitation, they must expressly request it and sign an Assignment of Economic Copyright Contract pursuant to Art. 128 of the INGENIOS Code, through a written instrument signed by both parties at a differentiated price. The moral rights of the author are non-waivable and inalienable pursuant to Art. 122 of the INGENIOS Code.
Regardless of the type of license contracted, the client is expressly prohibited from:
items: Reselling, sublicensing or transferring the material to third parties without written authorization from the Service Provider.
Removing, modifying or hiding the metadata, watermarks or any authorship indication of the material.

nine.subTitle: 8. CANCELLATION AND REFUND POLICY
text: In accordance with Art. 1505 and following of the Ecuadorian Civil Code and the applicable provisions of the Commercial Code:

description: Cancellations will only be accepted when notified in writing to the Service Provider at least seven (7) business days before the event date. Cancellations within this period will entitle the client to a 100% refund of the deposit.
If cancellation occurs less than seven (7) business days before or on the same day as the event, the deposit will be retained as compensation for the date reservation and operational costs incurred.
Applicable refunds will be made by bank transfer (savings or checking account) within five (5) business days following confirmation of the cancellation.

If the Service Provider cancels due to causes attributable to them, 100% of the deposit will be refunded. In case of force majeure or act of God (extreme adverse weather, flight ban, health emergency or other duly justified causes), a new date will be agreed upon at no additional cost or, if not possible, 100% of the deposit will be refunded.

ten.subTitle: 9. PRIVACY AND PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION
text: In accordance with the Organic Law on Personal Data Protection of Ecuador (Official Registry Supplement No. 459, May 26, 2021), JB.SKYLNES - DRON commits to:
items: Process the client's personal data solely for the purposes necessary for service execution, payment management and communication.
Not transfer, sell or share personal data with third parties without prior consent from the data subject, except as required by law.
Implement reasonable technical measures to protect personal information against unauthorized access or disclosure.
Respect the ARCO rights (Access, Rectification, Cancellation and Opposition) of the data subject, exercisable through a written request to the contact email.

description: The Service Provider will not be liable for the quality of the material when it is affected by adverse weather conditions, airspace restrictions, electronic interference or other circumstances beyond their control.

The client is responsible for obtaining the necessary permits from the owner or manager of the recording location and for ensuring minimum safety conditions for drone operation. Non-compliance exempts the Service Provider from any resulting liability.

lists.header: 10.3 Equipment Damage or Breakdown During Recording
description: In the event that the drone or other equipment used suffers damage, breakdown or loss during the course of a recording or event, provided that said damage is not exclusively attributable to one party alone, the economic responsibility will be shared equally: 50% by the Service Provider and 50% by the client.

Shared cause includes, among others: environmental interference, site conditions under the client's control, unauthorized handling of equipment by third parties present at the event, or any factor in which both parties had participation or knowledge. If the damage is exclusively attributable to the client or to third parties under their responsibility, the full cost of repair or replacement will be borne by the client.

Once the download link has been delivered, the Service Provider does not guarantee indefinite storage of the material on their servers. The client is advised to make backup copies immediately. The Service Provider will retain the material for a minimum of thirty (30) calendar days after delivery.

twelve.subTitle: 11. UNMANNED AERIAL VEHICLE OPERATIONS
text: Aerial capture services are provided in compliance with the regulations issued by the General Directorate of Civil Aviation (DGAC) of Ecuador and current regulations applicable to unmanned aerial vehicle systems (UAS/RPAS). The Service Provider reserves the right to suspend operations if conditions pose a risk to the safety of people, property or the aircraft, or if authorities prohibit it, in which case the provisions of Section 8.4 will apply.

thirteen.subTitle: 12. AMENDMENTS TO THESE TERMS
text: JB.SKYLNES - DRON reserves the right to modify these Terms at any time. Changes will take effect immediately upon publication at https://dron.joaobarres.dev. Continued use of the services will imply acceptance of the new terms. Amendments will not affect contracts already executed and in force at the time of the change, unless expressly agreed upon by both parties.

fourteen.subTitle: 13. DISPUTE RESOLUTION AND JURISDICTION
text: Any dispute arising from the interpretation, execution or breach of these Terms will be resolved, in the first instance, through direct good-faith negotiation. If no agreement is reached within fifteen (15) business days from the notification, the parties expressly submit to the jurisdiction and competence of the judges, courts and mediators of the city of Esmeraldas, province of Esmeraldas, Republic of Ecuador, waiving any other jurisdiction or venue. The parties may also resort to the alternative dispute resolution methods provided under the Arbitration and Mediation Law of Ecuador, before the competent mediation centers of the city of Esmeraldas.
